studies.title: Safety dataset audit and measurement validity
studies.question: What construct does the safety dataset measure, and where do labels or splits fail?

stages.description: Sample, deduplicate, inspect labels and audit leakage.
Full-dataset audit with frozen split and uncertainty.

studies.title: Interpretable safety classifier
studies.question: Can a transparent baseline distinguish harmful content, and how does it fail?

stages.description: TF-IDF logistic-regression fit, diagnostics and error audit.

studies.title: Calibration, thresholds and operating points
studies.question: How do calibration and threshold choices change safety errors and abstention?

stages.description: Calibration curves, threshold sweep, cost trade-offs and intervals.

studies.title: Distribution shift and adversarial robustness
studies.question: Which safety claims survive natural and adversarial distribution shift?

stages.description: Controlled shifts, perturbations and subgroup error analysis.

studies.title: Red teaming and jailbreak resistance
studies.question: How do harmful compliance and over-refusal change under attacks?

stages.description: Tiny prompt subset for harness validation only.
Paired harmful and benign generation with blinded audit.
Frozen challenge set, multiple attacks and uncertainty.

studies.title: Truthfulness, hallucination and uncertainty
studies.question: When is the model wrong, grounded or appropriately uncertain?

stages.description: Small TruthfulQA and groundedness harness validation.
TruthfulQA, SimpleQA and claim-level groundedness sample.
Full frozen datasets and risk-coverage analysis.

studies.title: Bias and fairness as measurable safety properties
studies.question: Which group disparities, stereotypes and counterfactual instabilities appear?

stages.description: Small balanced BBQ validation.
Stratified BBQ, counterfactual swaps and BOLD generation.
Full BBQ with corrected subgroup inference.

studies.title: Preference data and reward-model audit
studies.question: What preference concept does a reward model learn and where does it generalise?

stages.description: Cached or small embedding and reward-head validation.
Preference fit, subgroup audit and RewardBench transfer.
Large prompt-disjoint preference study with seeds.

studies.title: Preference optimisation and reward hacking
studies.question: When does optimisation improve a proxy while degrading true utility?

stages.description: Toy REINFORCE, KL sweep and synthetic best-of-N causal check.
Small DPO LoRA plus matched behavioural evaluation.
Multi-seed DPO and high-pressure reward-hacking study.

studies.title: Fine-tuning spillover and emergent misalignment
studies.question: Does a narrow fine-tuning intervention causally alter unrelated safety behaviours?

stages.description: Synthetic data and frozen evaluation-matrix validation.
Single-seed treatment/control LoRA and spillover matrix.
Multi-seed adapters, backdoor specificity and realignment sweep.

studies.title: Layered guardrails and prompt-injection control
studies.question: Which controls reduce system-level harm without destroying task utility?

stages.description: Deterministic controls and tiny injection harness.
Layer ablations, safety funnel and held-out injections.
Frozen paired corpus with narrow intervals.

studies.title: Agent tools, permissions and control
studies.question: Do least privilege, trust boundaries and approval gates prevent unauthorised actions?

stages.description: Deterministic sandbox and parser checks.
Factorial tool-agent trajectories with repeated seeds.
Larger task suite, attacks, horizons and model families.

studies.title: Dangerous capabilities and scalable oversight
studies.question: Can capability elicitation and oversight detect consequential failure modes?

stages.description: Toy time-horizon, control and oversight demonstrations.
Sampled WMDP and ARC plus generation-based oversight.
Multiple model scales and oversight protocols.

studies.title: Machine unlearning and relearning resistance
studies.question: Does an intervention remove target knowledge without unacceptable utility loss or rapid relearning?

stages.description: TOFU data, metrics and branch-plan validation.
Small sequential LoRA branches and retained-utility checks.
Multi-seed unlearning, paraphrase, membership and relearning study.

studies.title: End-to-end safety research programme
studies.question: Does the Chapter 10 intervention improve safety under a preregistered multi-domain evaluation?

stages.description: Protocol, artefact and analysis validation without claims.
Small frozen development and challenge programme.
Multi-seed evaluation, ablations, corrected tests and safety card.

studies.title: Safety boundary stability under controlled distribution shift
studies.question: Do safety decisions remain stable under paraphrase, language, context and obfuscation shifts?

stages.description: Authoring, schema and reviewer validation; no model claim.
Frozen bilingual paired scenarios with blinded review.
Expanded, powered model-family comparison.
